exercises.instructionEn: Match the sentences (a - g) to the pictures (1 - 7). Then, read out the events in the correct order. Can you guess who the young woman was?
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni (a - g) rasmlarga (1 - 7) moslang. So'ng voqealarni to'g'ri tartibda o'qing. Yosh ayol kim ekanini taxmin qila olasizmi?
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI RASM - YETTI VOQEA.


TO'G'RI TARTIB (rasm raqami bo'yicha):

  1 - d  Janice was watching TV.
  2 - a  Janice saw a young woman
         standing at the door.
  3 - f  Janice went to the telephone
         and asked the local taxi service
         to collect the young woman.
  4 - b  The woman's flowers were lying
         on the doormat.
  5 - e  When James got home, she was
         still sitting on the stairs with
         the flowers on her lap.
  6 - g  James noticed an old photograph.
  7 - c  James showed Janice the
         photograph.


⚠ YoSh AYoL KIM EDI:

  Rasmlarga qarang: 7-rasmda James
  ESKI SURATNI ko'rsatadi va Janice
  hayratda qoladi.

  ⚠ Demak suratdagi ayol - eshik oldida
  turgan yosh ayolning O'ZI.
  ⚠ Bu - ARVOH hikoyasi ('a ghost
  story') - 2-mashqning javobi.


⚠ MATNDAGI ZAMONLAR:

  PAST CONTINUOUS (davomli):
     'Janice WAS WATCHING TV.'
     'The flowers WERE LYING on the
      doormat.'
     'she WAS STILL SITTING on the
      stairs'

  PAST SIMPLE (bir martalik ish):
     'Janice SAW a young woman.'
     'Janice WENT to the telephone.'
     'James NOTICED an old photograph.'
     'James SHOWED Janice the
      photograph.'

  ⚠ Bu - 4-unitning grammatika mavzusi:
  past simple va past continuous farqi.


⚠ 'TO SEE SB DOING STH':

  'Janice saw a young woman STANDING at
   the door.'
  = turgan ayolni ko'rdi.

  ⚠ Ko'rish/eshitish fe'llaridan keyin
  -ING shakli JARAYoNNI bildiradi.


⚠ 'TO LIE' - IKKI XIL:

  'The flowers were LYING on the mat.'
  ⚠ lie - lay - lain (yotmoq)
  ⚠ -ING shakli: LYING ('lieing' XATO)

  ⚠ 17-betdagi maqolda ham 'lie' bor edi:
  'so you must lie upon it'.


⚠ 'A LAP':

  = tizza usti (o'tirganda).
  ⚠ 'with the flowers on her LAP' =
  gullar tizzasida.


⚠ 'TO COLLECT':

  = olib ketmoq, borib olmoq.
  ⚠ 'to collect sb' = kimnidir borib
  olmoq (mashinada).
  ⚠ Boshqa ma'nosi: to'plamoq
  (19-betda 'collectors' bor edi).

exercises.instructionEn: Guess the type of story. Is it a humorous story, a science fiction story, a crime story, a horror story, a love story, a ghost story or a fairy tale? Who are the characters in the story? What do you think it is about? Describe what you can see in the pictures.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoya turini taxmin qiling. Bu kulgili hikoyami, ilmiy-fantastikmi, jinoiy hikoyami, qo'rqinchli hikoyami, sevgi hikoyasimi, arvoh haqidagi hikoyami yoki ertakmi? Hikoyadagi qahramonlar kim? Sizningcha, u nima haqida? Rasmlarda nima ko'rayotganingizni tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYa TURLARI.

  a humorous story - kulgili hikoya
  a science fiction story - ilmiy-
     fantastik hikoya
  a crime story - jinoiy hikoya
  a horror story - qo'rqinchli hikoya
  a love story - sevgi hikoyasi
  a ghost story - arvoh haqidagi hikoya
  a fairy tale - ertak


⚠ QAYSI TUR:

  Rasmlarga qarang:
     • yosh ayol paydo bo'ladi va
       G'OYIB bo'ladi (2 va 4-rasm)
     • gullar qoladi
     • ESKI suratda o'sha ayol

  → Bu - GHOST STORY (arvoh haqidagi
  hikoya).


⚠ SO'ZLARNING TAHLILI:

  'humorous' - 'humour' (hazil) so'zidan
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'humour', AQShda 'humor',
  lekin sifat IKKALASIDA ham 'humorous'.

  'science fiction' - 'science' (fan) +
     'fiction' (badiiy to'qima)
  ⚠ Qisqartmasi: 'sci-fi' /ˌsaɪ ˈfaɪ/.

  'a crime' = jinoyat
  ⚠ 'a criminal' = jinoyatchi.

  'horror' = dahshat
  ⚠ 'horrible' = dahshatli.

  'a ghost' = arvoh, ruh
  ⚠ 'gh' - 'g' o'qiladi, 'h' JIM:
  /ɡəʊst/.

  'a fairy tale' = ertak
  ⚠ 'a fairy' = pari; 'a tale' = ertak,
  qissa.


⚠ 'A CHARACTER' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) qahramon (kitobda, filmda)
  2) xarakter, xislat (6-betda shu
     ma'noda edi)

  ⚠ Bu yerda BIRINChI ma'no.

TAXMIN QILIB, KEYIN TEKShIRISh.

  ⚠ Bu usul 'predict and check' deb
  ataladi: avval rasm va sarlavhaga
  qarab TAXMIN qilinadi, keyin
  tinglab yoki o'qib TEKShIRILADI.

  ⚠ Taxmin qilgan o'quvchi matnni
  ancha yaxshi tushunadi - chunki u
  ALLAQAChON javob izlayotgan bo'ladi.

  * ⚠ Kassetada hikoya o'qiladi -
    lekin matnning O'ZI 27-betda bor,
    shuning uchun tekshirish audiosiz
    ham mumkin.


⚠ 'IF' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) AGAR (shart):
     'If it rains, we'll stay at home.'
  2) ...MI (o'zlashtirma so'roq):
     'Check IF your guesses were correct.'
     = taxminlaringiz to'g'ri ekanINI
       tekshiring

  ⚠ Ikkinchi ma'noda 'whether' bilan
  almashtirish mumkin.


⚠ 'A GUESS':

  'to guess' (fe'l) = taxmin qilmoq
  'a guess' (ot) = taxmin
  ⚠ 'u' JIM: /ɡes/.

HAMMA IBORA HIKOYaDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  it SOUNDS like    - ... ga o'xshaydi
  the FRONT door    - oldingi eshik
  a local TAXI service - mahalliy taksi

⚠ 'IT SOUNDS LIKE ...':

  ⚠ 'to sound' - HIS fe'li, keyin SIFAT

     'It sounds interesting.' (sifat)

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'look like',
  'feel like', 'taste like', 'smell
  like'.


⚠ 'THE FRONT DOOR' va 'THE BACK DOOR':

  front door - ko'chaga chiqadigan eshik
  back door - orqa eshik (hovliga)


⚠ 'AN ANNIVERSARY':

  = yillik.
  ⚠ Lotincha 'annus' (yil) + 'versus'
  (aylanish).
  ⚠ Imlosi: IKKI 'n', IKKI 's'.

  ⚠ 'a birthday' - odam uchun;
  'an anniversary' - VOQEA uchun
  (to'y, tashkil topish).


⚠ 'A BOUQUET OF FLOWERS':

  ⚠ 'a bunch of flowers' ham to'g'ri va
  ko'proq ishlatiladi.
  ⚠ 'bouquet' - fransuzcha, /buˈkeɪ/.


⚠ 'TO CHANGE ONE'S CLOTHES':

  ⚠ 'one's' o'rniga egalik olmoshi:
  'change HIS clothes', 'change MY
  clothes'.
  ⚠ 'clothes' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.

exercises.explanationUz:
YAQIN MA'NOLI SO'ZLARNI FARQLASh.


⚠ 'ALONE' va 'LONELY':

  alone = yolg'iz (HOLAT: birov yo'q)
  lonely = yolg'izlikdan qiynalgan
     (HIS-TUYG'U)

  ⚠ 'I live alone but I'm not lonely.'
  = Yolg'iz yashayman, lekin
    zerikmayman.

  ⚠ Hikoyada: 'Janice was ALONE in the
  house' - shunchaki birov yo'q edi.


⚠ 'TO LAY' va 'TO LIE' - ENG QIYIN
JUFTLIK:

  to LIE (yotmoq) - O'TIMSIZ:
     lie - lay - lain; -ing: LYING
     'The book is LYING on the table.'

  to LAY (qo'ymoq) - O'TIMLI:
     lay - laid - laid; -ing: LAYING
     'She is LAYING the table.'

  ⚠ Chalkashlik sababi: 'lie' ning
  O'TGAN ZAMONI 'LAY' - ya'ni 'lay'
  fe'lining O'ZI bilan bir xil!

  ⚠ Hikoyada: 'her flowers were LYING
  on the doormat' - gullar O'ZI yotardi.


⚠ 'TO CHANGE' va 'TO CANCEL':

  to change = o'zgartirmoq
  to cancel = BEKOR qilmoq

  ⚠ 3-bandda 'raining heavily' sababli
  sayohat BEKOR qilingan - 'changed'
  emas.


⚠ 'TIME' va 'AN HOUR':

  time = vaqt (umuman); soat
     ko'rsatgan vaqt
  an hour = 60 daqiqa

  ⚠ 'Your watch shows the correct TIME.'
  ⚠ 'The film lasts two HOURS.'


⚠ 'KNOWN' va 'FAMILIAR':

  known = mashhur, tanilgan
     ('well known for' - 8-betda)
  familiar = tanish (ilgari ko'rgan)

  ⚠ 'She looks FAMILIAR to me.' =
  Uni qayerdadir ko'rganga o'xshayman.
  ⚠ Hikoyada: 'There was something
  FAMILIAR about the woman.'

exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI HIKOYaDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  AT night          - kechasi
  waiting FOR sb    - kimnidir kutmoq
  to call FOR a taxi - taksi chaqirmoq
  to tell sb ABOUT sth - kimgadir
                      nimadir haqida
                      aytmoq
  to sit ON the stairs - zinapoyada
                      o'tirmoq
  to turn ON the light - chiroq yoqmoq
  ON sb's wedding day - kimningdir to'y
                      kunida


⚠ 'AT NIGHT' - ISTISNO:

  IN the morning / afternoon / evening
  AT night

  ⚠ 'in the night' ham uchraydi, lekin
  boshqa ma'noda ('tun davomida').


⚠ 'TO WAIT FOR':

  ⚠ 'wait' PREDLOGSIZ ishlatilmaydi
  (odam yoki narsa bilan):
  'wait FOR the bus', 'wait FOR me'.


⚠ 'TO CALL FOR' va 'TO CALL':

  'to call sb' = kimgadir qo'ng'iroq
     qilmoq
  'to call FOR a taxi' = taksi
     ChAQIRMOQ

  ⚠ Ikki ibora BOShQA ma'noda.


⚠ 'TO TELL SB ABOUT STH':

  ⚠ 'tell' dan keyin ODAM predlogsiz:
  'tell ME about it'.
  ⚠ 'say' dan keyin esa 'to':
  'say something TO me'.


⚠ 'TO TURN ON' va 'TO TURN OFF':

  turn on = yoqmoq (chiroq, televizor)
  turn off = o'chirmoq

  ⚠ 'on' va 'off' - ZARRAChA, shuning
  uchun to'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi
  mumkin: 'turn IT on'.


⚠ 'ON SB'S WEDDING DAY':

  ⚠ Kun oldidan 'ON': on Monday,
  on 15th April, on my birthday.

exercises.explanationUz:
KUChLIROQ SIFATLAR.

  ⚠ Ro'yxatdagi sifatlar oddiy
  sifatlarning KUChLI shakli:

     frightened → TERRIFIED
        (qo'rqqan → dahshatga tushgan)
     big → HUGE
        (katta → ulkan)
     small → TINY
        (kichik → juda kichkina)
     glad → RELIEVED
        (xursand → yengil tortgan)
     tired → EXHAUSTED
        (charchagan → holdan toygan)


⚠ KUChLI SIFATLAR BILAN 'VERY'
IShLATILMAYDI:

  ✓ very big → ✗ very huge
  ✓ very tired → ✗ very exhausted

  ⚠ Ular o'rniga 'absolutely' yoki
  'completely' ishlatiladi:
     'absolutely huge'
     'completely exhausted'


MATNNING TO'LIQ ShAKLI:

  'Sam heard the fireman knock on the
   window. He was TERRIFIED, but he
   knew he had to get out. The flames
   were HUGE and he was very hot.
   Slowly, he moved towards the window.
   It was TINY and Sam didn't know if
   he could get through. He managed
   after many attempts and when he
   reached the ground he felt very
   RELIEVED. He suddenly realised that
   he was EXHAUSTED. All he wanted to do
   was to sleep.'


⚠ 'TO HEAR SB DO STH':

  'Sam heard the fireman KNOCK on the
   window.'
  ⚠ 'hear' dan keyin 'to' SIZ infinitiv -
  ish TUGAGANINI bildiradi.
  ⚠ 'heard him KNOCKING' - jarayonni
  bildiradi.


⚠ 'TO MANAGE':

  = uddasidan chiqmoq.
  ⚠ 'to manage TO DO sth' - infinitiv
  bilan.
  ⚠ Boshqa ma'nosi: boshqarmoq
  (21-betda 'management').


⚠ 'AN ATTEMPT':

  = urinish.
  ⚠ 'to attempt' = urinmoq.


⚠ 'RELIEVED':

  = yengil tortgan (xavf o'tgach).
  ⚠ 'relief' (ot) = yengillik.
  ⚠ 'What a relief!' = xayriyat!

exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri ravishni qo'ying, so'ng ravishlar qanday yasalishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
RAVISh YaSASh QOIDALARI.


1) ODDIY: SIFAT + -LY

  sudden → suddenLY
  loud   → loudLY


2) '-LE' BILAN TUGASA: '-LE' → '-LY'

  gentle → gentLY
  terrible → terribLY
  simple → simpLY

  ⚠ 'gentlely' - XATO.


3) '-AL' BILAN TUGASA: + -LY

  final → finalLY (IKKI 'l')
  usual → usualLY
  normal → normalLY

  ⚠ 'finaly' - XATO, ikkita 'l' kerak.


4) UNDOSh + 'Y' → '-ILY'

  pretty → prettILY
  heavy → heavILY
  happy → happILY
  easy → easILY


5) O'ZGARMAYDIGANLAR:

  hard → hard
  fast → fast
  late → late
  early → early
  straight → straight

  ⚠ 'fastly' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'hardly' MAVJUD, lekin 'deyarli
  emas' ma'nosida - BOShQA so'z.


6) QOIDASIZ:

  good → WELL

  ⚠ 'goodly' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'well' yana SIFAT ham bo'ladi:
  'I'm well' = sog'lomman.


⚠ 'PRETTILY' - KAM IShLATILADI:

  ⚠ 'pretty' ko'proq RAVISh sifatida
  ishlatiladi va 'ancha' ma'nosini
  beradi: 'pretty good' = ancha yaxshi.

YETIShMAYOTGAN GAPNI TOPISh.

TO'RT GAP:

  hayratda qoldirmoq).


⚠ 'TO PICK UP':

  = yerdan olmoq, ko'tarmoq.
  ⚠ Yana: 'to pick sb up' = mashinada
  borib olmoq.


⚠ 'TO CANCEL':

  = bekor qilmoq.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'cancelLED' (ikki 'l'),
  AQShda 'canceled'.


⚠ 'ANYWHERE':

  = hech qayerda (inkor gapda).
  ⚠ "couldn't see her ANYWHERE" =
  uni HECh QAYERDA ko'rmadi.
  ⚠ 'nowhere' bilan bir xil ma'no,
  lekin 'nowhere' TASDIQ fe'l bilan
  keladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaNING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan (bo'shliqlar
to'ldirilgan holda).


⚠ HIKOYaNING SIRI:

  Eshik oldiga kelgan yosh ayol -
  Jeymsning BUVISI, 1910-yil 15-aprelda
  turmushga chiqqan.
  U o'sha kuni - TO'Y YILLIGIda -
  qaytib kelgan.

  ⚠ Ya'ni bu ARVOH haqidagi hikoya
  (26-betdagi 2-mashqning javobi).


⚠ SO'NGGI GAP - KALIT:

  "Well, that's her in the photograph -
   and today is 15th April. It's her
   WEDDING ANNIVERSARY."

  ⚠ 'an anniversary' = yillik.
  ⚠ 'a wedding anniversary' = to'y
  yilligi.


⚠ MATNDAGI ZAMONLAR - 4-UNIT
GRAMMATIKASI:

  PAST CONTINUOUS (uzun, fon):
     'Janice WAS ALONE ... WAITING for
      her husband'
     'It WAS RAINING heavily'
     'the wind WAS BLOWING'
     'She WAS WATCHING TV'
     'she WAS WEARING a long white dress'
     'her flowers WERE LYING on the
      doormat'
     'she WAS STILL SITTING on the stairs'
     'It WAS TICKING loudly'

  PAST SIMPLE (qisqa, bir martalik):
     'the doorbell RANG'
     'she OPENED the door'
     'the young woman SAID'
     'Janice REPLIED'
     'She WENT to the telephone'
     'She SAT DOWN on the stairs'
     'James LAUGHED'
     'he HEARD the sound'
     'He WENT into the room and TURNED
      ON the light'

  ⚠ Qoida: uzun ish - CONTINUOUS,
  uni bo'lgan qisqa ish - SIMPLE.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  alone       = yolg'iz
  heavily     = qattiq (yomg'ir haqida)
  to blow     = esmoq (shamol)
  sweetly     = shirin ohangda
  to reply    = javob bermoq
  a taxi service = taksi xizmati
  to collect  = borib olmoq
  puzzled     = hayron, tushunmayotgan
  a lap       = tizza usti
  a ghost     = arvoh
  softly      = sekin, ohista
  a wedding anniversary = to'y yilligi

tasks.uz: "Kechirasiz", - dedi yosh ayol shirin ohangda. "Telefoningizdan taksi chaqirsam bo'ladimi?"
tasks.note:
⚠ 'sweetly' - RAVISh ('sweet' + -ly).
⚠ 'Would it be all right if I used ...?' -
juda MULOYIM iltimos (past simple ishlatiladi).
⚠ 'to call FOR a taxi' - predlog 'for'
(8-mashqda).

tasks.en: "Oh, yes, of course," Janice replied. "I'll call one for you now."
tasks.uz: "Ha, albatta", - javob berdi Janice. "Hozir sizga chaqiraman".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to reply' = javob bermoq ('to reply TO sb').
⚠ "I'll" - shu daqiqada qabul qilingan qaror.
⚠ 'one' = 'a taxi' (takrorlamaslik uchun).

tasks.en: She went to the telephone, asked the local taxi service to collect the young woman, and returned to the front door.
tasks.uz: U telefonga bordi, mahalliy taksi xizmatidan yosh ayolni olib ketishni so'radi va oldingi eshikka qaytdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to ask sb TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.
⚠ 'to collect sb' = borib olmoq.
⚠ 'the front door' = ko'chaga chiqadigan eshik
(6-mashqda).

tasks.en: The young woman wasn't there, but her flowers were lying on the doormat.
tasks.uz: Yosh ayol u yerda yo'q edi, lekin gullari poyandozda yotardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'were lying' - PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'lying' - 'lie' fe'lidan ('lieing' XATO).
⚠ 7-mashqda 'laying/lying' ataylab qarshi
qo'yilgan.

tasks.en: [2 = A] Janice couldn't see her anywhere, so she picked up the flowers, went inside and phoned the taxi service again to cancel the call.
tasks.uz: [2 = A] Janice uni hech qayerda ko'rmadi, shuning uchun gullarni oldi, ichkariga kirdi va chaqiruvni bekor qilish uchun taksi xizmatiga yana qo'ng'iroq qildi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 4-mashqning 2-javobi.
⚠ 'anywhere' - INKOR gapda 'hech qayerda'.
⚠ 'to cancel' - Britaniyada 'cancelLED'
(7-mashqda).

tasks.en: She sat down on the stairs, puzzled by the young woman's mysterious disappearance.
tasks.uz: U yosh ayolning sirli g'oyib bo'lishidan hayron bo'lib zinapoyaga o'tirdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'puzzled' = hayron, tushunmayotgan.
⚠ 'to sit ON the stairs' - predlog 'on'
(8-mashqda).
⚠ 'a disappearance' = g'oyib bo'lish
('to disappear' fe'lidan).

tasks.en: There was something familiar about the woman, but Janice couldn't think what it was.
tasks.uz: Ayolda tanish nimadir bor edi, lekin Janice u nima ekanini o'ylab topolmadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'familiar' = tanish (7-mashqda).
⚠ 'something familiar' - SIFAT 'something' dan
KEYIN turadi.
⚠ 'what it was' - o'zlashtirma so'roq: so'z
tartibi ODDIY.

tasks.en: When James got home half an hour later, she was still sitting on the stairs with the flowers on her lap.
tasks.uz: Yarim soatdan keyin Jeyms uyga kelganda, u hamon zinapoyada gullar tizzasida o'tirardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'got home' (qisqa) + 'was sitting' (uzun) -
yana 4-unit qolipi.
⚠ 'half an hour' - 'AN hour' ('h' o'qilmaydi).
⚠ 'a lap' = tizza usti.

tasks.en: "What's the matter?" he asked. "You look as if you've seen a ghost."
tasks.uz: "Nima bo'ldi?" - so'radi u. "Arvoh ko'rganga o'xshaysan".
tasks.note:
⚠ "What's the matter?" = nima bo'ldi?
⚠ 'You look AS IF ...' = ... ga o'xshaysan.
⚠ 'to see a ghost' - shu ibora hikoyaning
MAVZUSIGA ishora qiladi.

tasks.en: "Perhaps I have," she said jokingly. She showed James the flowers, and told him about the strange woman.
tasks.uz: "Balki ko'rgandirman", - dedi u hazillashib. U Jeymsga gullarni ko'rsatdi va g'alati ayol haqida aytib berdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'Perhaps I have' = 'Perhaps I have seen a
ghost' - takroriy qism TUShIRIB QOLDIRILGAN.
⚠ 'jokingly' - RAVISh ('a joke' so'zidan).
⚠ 'to tell sb ABOUT sth' - predlog 'about'
(8-mashqda).

tasks.en: James laughed, then went upstairs to change his clothes.
tasks.uz: Jeyms kuldi, keyin kiyimini almashtirish uchun yuqoriga chiqdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to change one's clothes' = kiyim almashtirmoq
(6-mashqda).
⚠ 'upstairs' - PREDLOGSIZ ravish.
⚠ MAQSAD uchun INFINITIV: 'TO change'.

tasks.en: As he was going past the guest room, he heard the sound of a clock ticking.
tasks.uz: Mehmonxona yonidan o'tayotganda soatning chiqillashini eshitdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'As he WAS GOING' (uzun) + 'he HEARD' (qisqa).
⚠ 'past' bu yerda PREDLOG: 'yonidan o'tib'
(9-betdagi xatda ham bor edi).
⚠ 'a clock ticking' = chiqillayotgan soat
(6-mashqda).

tasks.en: "It sounds like the clock my grandparents had when I was a child," James thought, "but that stopped working twenty years ago."
tasks.uz: "Bu bolaligimda buvim-bobomda bo'lgan soatga o'xshaydi", - deb o'yladi Jeyms, "lekin u yigirma yil oldin ishlamay qolgan".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'It sounds like ...' = ... ga o'xshaydi
(6-mashqda).
⚠ 'to stop DOING sth' = qilishni to'xtatmoq;
'to stop TO DO sth' - butunlay boshqa ma'no!
⚠ 'ago' - gap oxirida.

tasks.en: He went into the room and turned on the light. His grandparents were no longer alive, but many of their things were still there.
tasks.uz: U xonaga kirdi va chiroqni yoqdi. Buvi-bobosi endi tirik emas edi, lekin ularning ko'p narsalari hamon u yerda edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to turn ON the light' = chiroq yoqmoq
(8-mashqda). Aksi: 'to turn off'.
⚠ 'no longer' = endi ... emas.
⚠ 'alive' - SIFAT, otdan OLDIN turmaydi
('an alive man' XATO; 'a living man').

tasks.en: James looked around and saw his grandparents' clock. It was ticking loudly and it showed the correct time.
tasks.uz: Jeyms atrofga qaradi va buvi-bobosining soatini ko'rdi. U qattiq chiqillayotgan va to'g'ri vaqtni ko'rsatardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ "grandparents'" - KO'PLIKDA egalik:
apostrof -S dan KEYIN.
⚠ 'the correct time' - 7-mashqda 'time/hour'
qarshi qo'yilgan.
⚠ 'loudly' - RAVISh.

tasks.en: [3 = D] Then James noticed an old photograph next to the clock. It was a picture of a young couple on their wedding day, with "15th April, 1910" written on the photograph.
tasks.uz: [3 = D] Keyin Jeyms soat yonidagi eski suratni payqab qoldi. Bu to'y kunidagi yosh juftlikning surati edi, unda "1910-yil 15-aprel" deb yozilgan edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 4-mashqning 3-javobi.
⚠ 'ON sb's wedding day' - predlog 'on'
(8-mashqda).
⚠ '15th April, 1910' - Britaniya sanasi:
kun → oy → yil.

tasks.en: James took the picture and went downstairs. "I know who the young woman was," he said softly, showing Janice the photograph.
tasks.uz: Jeyms suratni oldi va pastga tushdi. "Yosh ayol kim ekanini bilaman", - dedi u ohista, Janice'ga suratni ko'rsatib.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'downstairs' - PREDLOGSIZ.
⚠ 'who the young woman was' - o'zlashtirma
so'roq, so'z tartibi ODDIY.
⚠ 'softly' - RAVISh ('soft' + -ly).

tasks.en: [4 = B] Janice looked at it and gasped in amazement. The bride was wearing the same white dress as the young woman, and the flowers she was holding in the photograph were just like the ones Janice had.
tasks.uz: [4 = B] Janice unga qaradi va hayratdan nafasi bo'g'ildi. Kelin yosh ayolnikidek oq ko'ylak kiygan, suratdagi gullari esa Janice'dagi gullarga o'xshash edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 4-mashqning 4-javobi.
⚠ 'to gasp in amazement' (6-mashqda).
⚠ 'the same ... AS' - 22-betdagi qoida.
⚠ 'the ones' = 'the flowers' (takrorlamaslik
uchun).

tasks.en: "My grandmother died before I met you, didn't she?" James said. "Well, that's her in the photograph - and today is 15th April. It's her wedding anniversary."
tasks.uz: "Buvim men seni uchratishimdan oldin vafot etgan edi, shundaymi?" - dedi Jeyms. "Xo'sh, suratdagi - o'sha, va bugun 15-aprel. Bugun uning to'y yilligi".
tasks.note:
⚠ "didn't she?" - QUESTION TAG (15-unit mavzusi).
⚠ 'an anniversary' = yillik (6-mashqda).
⚠ Bu - hikoyaning KALIT gapi: yosh ayol
Jeymsning BUVISI edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story again and correct the statements.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani qayta o'qing va gaplarni to'g'rilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  1  Janice was reading a book when the
     doorbell rang.
     → "She wasn't reading a book.
        She was watching TV."

  ⚠ IKKI QADAM:
     1) INKOR bilan rad etish
     2) TO'G'RI ma'lumot

  ⚠ 21-betdagi 20-mashq bilan bir xil
  g'oya, lekin bu yerda hamma gap
  PAST CONTINUOUS da.


TO'G'RI MA'LUMOTLAR:

  1  watching TV (reading a book emas)
  2  a LONG white dress (short emas)
  3  a BOUQUET OF FLOWERS (a clock emas)
  4  SITTING on the stairs (sleeping
     emas)


⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS INKORI:

  She WASN'T reading.
  They WEREN'T sitting.

  ⚠ 'was/were' + not + fe'l + -ing.

exercises.instructionEn: Up, Up and Away!
exercises.instructionUz: Yuqoriga, yuqoriga va uzoqqa!
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaNING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan (bo'shliqlar
to'ldirilgan holda).


⚠ SARLAVHA: 'UP, UP AND AWAY!'

  = Yuqoriga, yuqoriga va uzoqqa!
  ⚠ Bu - mashhur qo'shiq nomi
  (1967-yil, 'Up, Up and Away' -
  havo shari haqida).
  ⚠ Takrorlangan 'up' - ko'tarilish
  hissini beradi.


HIKOYaNING TUZILIShI
(29-betdagi quti bo'yicha):

  BOShLANISh:
     WHEN: 'As soon as Fay woke up ...
        It was a sunny morning'
     WHO: Fay va uning do'sti Bob
     WHAT FIRST: 'Bob picked her up in
        his car'

  ASOSIY QISM:
     havo shariga chiqish → momaqaldiroq
     → chaqmoq → Fay boshini urish →
     daraxtga qo'nish → o't o'chiruvchilar

  TUGASh:
     WHAT IN THE END: 'Fay and Bob were
        standing safely on the ground'
     HOW FELT: "We're safe at last!"


⚠ ZAMONLAR - 4-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI:

  PAST CONTINUOUS (fon):
     'a gentle breeze WAS BLOWING'
     'Dark clouds WERE RACING towards
      them'
     'they WERE HANGING from a branch'
     'Its siren WAS WAILING'
     'its red lights WERE FLASHING'

  PAST SIMPLE (voqealar):
     'Fay WOKE UP', 'Bob PICKED her up',
     'they CLIMBED into the basket',
     'the balloon BEGAN to rise',
     'Fay FELL backwards and HIT her
      head'


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  to pick sb up - borib olmoq
  a ride        - sayr (transportda)
  to rise       - ko'tarilmoq
  cheerfully    - quvnoq
  to reply      - javob bermoq
  to shake violently - qattiq silkinmoq
  a worried face - xavotirli yuz
  to land       - qo'nmoq
  a branch      - shox
  brightly      - yorqin
  to have in mind - ko'zda tutmoq

tasks.en: Up, Up and Away!
tasks.uz: Yuqoriga, yuqoriga va uzoqqa!

tasks.en: As soon as Fay woke up, she knew this birthday was going to be very special. It was a sunny morning and a gentle breeze was blowing in through the window.
tasks.uz: Fey uyg'onishi bilanoq bu tug'ilgan kun juda alohida bo'lishini bildi. Quyoshli tong edi va derazadan mayin shabada esib turardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'as soon as' = ... ishi bilanoq.
⚠ 'was going to be' - o'tmishdagi kelajak
(5-unit mavzusi).
⚠ 'was blowing' - FON → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'a breeze' = mayin shabada.

tasks.en: "A perfect day for a balloon ride!" Fay said excitedly to herself.
tasks.uz: "Havo sharida sayr qilish uchun mukammal kun!" - dedi Fey o'ziga hayajon bilan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'excitedly' - RAVISh ('excited' + -ly).
⚠ 'to say to oneself' = o'ziga aytmoq (o'ylamoq).
⚠ 'a ride' = sayr (transportda).

tasks.en: Half an hour later, her friend Bob picked her up in his car. For her birthday present, Bob, a pilot, was taking Fay for a ride in a hot-air balloon.
tasks.uz: Yarim soatdan keyin do'sti Bob uni mashinasida olib ketdi. Tug'ilgan kun sovg'asi sifatida uchuvchi Bob Feyni havo sharida sayrga olib bormoqchi edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to pick sb up' = borib olmoq.
⚠ 'was taking' - REJALAShTIRILGAN ish
(past continuous kelajak ma'nosida).
⚠ 'Bob, a pilot,' - IZOh, verguller bilan.

tasks.en: Fay was thrilled when she saw the huge, bright yellow hot-air balloon. Bob made sure that everything was okay, then they climbed carefully into the basket.
tasks.uz: Fey ulkan, yorqin sariq havo sharini ko'rganda juda xursand bo'ldi. Bob hamma narsa joyidaligiga ishonch hosil qildi, keyin ular ehtiyotkorlik bilan savatga chiqishdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'thrilled' - 28-betdagi 15-mashqda ham bor edi.
⚠ 'huge' - 28-betdagi 9-mashqda.
⚠ SIFATLAR TARTIBI: huge (o'lcham) → bright
yellow (rang) → hot-air (tur) → balloon.

tasks.en: Moments later, the balloon began to rise slowly into the air. "This is fantastic!" she shouted cheerfully to Bob.
tasks.uz: Bir necha lahzadan keyin shar sekin havoga ko'tarila boshladi. "Bu ajoyib!" - deb qichqirdi u Bobga quvnoq ohangda.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to rise' - O'TIMSIZ: rise - rose - risen
(o'zi ko'tariladi).
⚠ 'to raise' - O'TIMLI: biror narsani ko'tarmoq.
⚠ 'cheerfully' - RAVISh.

tasks.en: "Happy Birthday! I'm glad you like your present!" he replied.
tasks.uz: "Tug'ilgan kuning bilan! Sovg'ang yoqqanidan xursandman!" - javob berdi u.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to reply' = javob bermoq (27-betdagi
hikoyada ham bor edi).
⚠ "I'm glad (that) you like ..." - 'that'
tushirib qoldiriladi.

tasks.en: Suddenly, the smile disappeared from Bob's face. Dark clouds were racing towards them and, before he could say anything, there was a loud rumble of thunder.
tasks.uz: To'satdan Bobning yuzidan tabassum yo'qoldi. Qora bulutlar ular tomon shitob bilan kelayotgan edi va u biror narsa aytishga ulgurmasidan momaqaldiroq gumburladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'Suddenly' - voqeaning burilish nuqtasi.
⚠ 'were racing' - FON → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'a rumble of thunder' - 28-betdagi 14-mashqda
'thunder rumbling' bor edi.

tasks.en: The balloon shook violently from side to side. "Oh, no!" screamed Fay. "We're going to die!"
tasks.uz: Shar u yoqdan-bu yoqqa qattiq silkindi. "Voy!" - qichqirdi Fey. "Biz o'lamiz!"
tasks.note:
⚠ 'shook' - 'shake' ning o'tgan zamoni
(shake - shook - shaken).
⚠ 'violently' - 28-betdagi 11-mashqda.
⚠ "We're going to die" - DALILGA asoslangan
taxmin (5-unit mavzusi).

tasks.en: Just as Bob was reaching for the radio, there was a bright flash of lightning. Fay fell backwards and hit her head, and everything went black.
tasks.uz: Bob radioga qo'l cho'zayotgan paytda yorqin chaqmoq chaqdi. Fey orqasiga yiqildi va boshini urdi, hammasi qorayib ketdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'Just as ... was reaching' (uzun) +
'there was' (qisqa) - 17-mashqning 'c'
qo'llanishi.
⚠ 'lightning' = chaqmoq (YoRUG'LIK);
'thunder' = momaqaldiroq (TOVUSh).
⚠ 'everything went black' = hushidan ketdi.

tasks.en: When Fay opened her eyes, she saw Bob's worried face in front of her. "Are you alright?" he asked anxiously.
tasks.uz: Fey ko'zini ochganda oldida Bobning xavotirli yuzini ko'rdi. "Yaxshimisan?" - so'radi u xavotir bilan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'worried' = xavotirlangan.
⚠ 'anxiously' - RAVISh; 'anxious' 28-betdagi
15-mashqda bor edi.
⚠ 'in front of' = oldida.

tasks.en: "The balloon went down," he explained, "but fortunately we've landed in a tree. I've already radioed for help."
tasks.uz: "Shar pastga tushdi", - tushuntirdi u, "lekin yaxshiyamki daraxtga qo'ndik. Men allaqachon yordam so'rab radio orqali xabar berdim".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'fortunately' = yaxshiyamki (13-betdagi
matnda ham bor edi).
⚠ "we've landed", "I've radioed" - PRESENT
PERFECT: natijasi hozir ham bor.
⚠ 'to radio' - OT ham, FE'L ham.

tasks.en: Fay looked over the side of the basket and realised that they were hanging from a branch. "Don't worry," said Bob calmly. "It'll hold us."
tasks.uz: Fey savatning chetidan qaradi va ularning shoxga ilinib turganini angladi. "Xavotir olma", - dedi Bob xotirjam. "U bizni ushlab turadi".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'were hanging' - FON → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'a branch' = shox.
⚠ 'calmly' - RAVISh; 'calm' da 'l' O'QILMAYDI.
⚠ "It'll" = 'it will' - taxmin.

tasks.en: At that moment a fire engine appeared. Its siren was wailing and its red lights were flashing brightly.
tasks.uz: Shu payt o't o'chirish mashinasi paydo bo'ldi. Sirenasi uvillayotgan va qizil chiroqlari yorqin miltillayotgan edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'appeared' (qisqa) + 'was wailing',
'were flashing' (uzun) - IKKI zamon birga.
⚠ 'a siren wailing' - 28-betdagi 14-mashqda.
⚠ 'ITS' - apostrofsiz (egalik).

tasks.en: Two firefighters jumped out and, five minutes later, Fay and Bob were standing safely on the ground. "We're safe at last!" Fay cried.
tasks.uz: Ikki o't o'chiruvchi sakrab tushdi va besh daqiqadan keyin Fey bilan Bob yerda xavfsiz turishardi. "Nihoyat xavfsizmiz!" - deb xitob qildi Fey.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'were standing' - NATIJADAGI holat →
PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'safely' - RAVISh; 'safe' - SIFAT.
⚠ 'at last' = nihoyat.
⚠ 'to cry' bu yerda = xitob qilmoq (yig'lamoq
emas).

tasks.en: "Fay, I'm sorry," replied Bob. "It wasn't quite what I had in mind, but I'm sure you won't forget this birthday!"
tasks.uz: "Fey, kechir", - javob berdi Bob. "Bu men ko'zda tutgan narsa emas edi, lekin ishonchim komil, bu tug'ilgan kunni unutmaysan!"
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to have sth in mind' = ko'zda tutmoq.
⚠ 'quite' = butunlay (inkorda: 'unchalik emas').
⚠ "you won't forget" - kelajak haqida taxmin.
⚠ Bu gap UNIT NOMIGA ishora: 'Days to Remember'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Which shows: a hot-air balloon hanging from a tree branch? someone reaching for a radio? someone climbing into a hot-air balloon basket? a bright flash of lightning? a fire engine?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Qaysi biri ko'rsatadi: daraxt shoxiga ilingan havo sharini? radioga qo'l cho'zayotgan odamni? havo shari savatiga chiqayotgan odamni? yorqin chaqmoqni? o't o'chirish mashinasini?
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT RASM - BESh BAND.

  ⚠ B rasmida IKKI narsa bor: chaqmoq
  va radioga qo'l cho'zayotgan odam.


RASMLAR:

  A - havo shari savatiga chiqayotgan
      ikki kishi (maysazorda)
  B - savatdagi ikki kishi; chapda
      binafsha ChAQMOQ; Bob radioga
      qo'l cho'zmoqda
  C - daraxtga ilinib qolgan sariq shar
  D - qizil o't o'chirish mashinasi


⚠ RASM TARTIBI HIKOYaGA MOS:

  A → B → C → D
  ⚠ Ya'ni rasmlar hikoyaning KETMA-
  KETLIGIni ko'rsatadi.


⚠ 'TO REACH FOR STH':

  = qo'l cho'zmoq.
  ⚠ 'to reach' (predlogsiz) = yetib
  bormoq (25-betdagi 8-mashqda).
  ⚠ 'to reach FOR' = qo'l cho'zmoq -
  BOShQA ma'no.


⚠ 'A FLASH OF LIGHTNING':

  = chaqmoq chaqishi.
  ⚠ 'lightning' - SANALMAYDIGAN,
  shuning uchun 'a flash of' kerak.
  ⚠ 'lightning' (chaqmoq) va
  'lightening' (yengillashtirish) -
  imlosi boshqa!


⚠ 'A FIRE ENGINE':

  = o't o'chirish mashinasi.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'a fire engine',
  AQShda 'a fire truck'.
  ⚠ 21-betdagi Harrods matnida
  'a fire brigade' bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story and fill in the numbered gaps with verbs from the list. Then, explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani o'qing va raqamlangan bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi fe'llar bilan to'ldiring. So'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI BO'ShLIQ - HAMMASI PAST
CONTINUOUS.

  ⚠ Ro'yxatdagi hamma fe'l
  'was/were + -ing' shaklida -

exercises.instructionEn: Adjectives describe nouns. Adverbs usually describe verbs or other adverbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlar otni tasvirlaydi. Ravishlar odatda fe'l yoki boshqa ravishni tasvirlaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI.

  'ADJECTIVES describe NOUNS.
   ADVERBS usually describe VERBS or
   other adverbs.'

  'She was holding a bouquet of PRETTY
   flowers.'  (sifat + ot)
  '"Excuse me," the young woman said
   SWEETLY.'  (fe'l + ravish)


⚠ ASOSIY FARQ:

  SIFAT → QANDAY? (ot haqida)
     'a pretty flower' - qanday gul?

  RAVISh → QANDAY QILIB? (fe'l haqida)
     'she said sweetly' - qanday aytdi?


⚠ RAVISh QANDAY YaSALADI:

  SIFAT + -LY:
     sweet → sweetly
     soft  → softly
     loud  → loudly
     heavy → heavily (undosh + y → -ily)
     terrible → terribly ('-le' → '-ly')


⚠ QOIDASIZ RAVIShLAR:

  good → WELL   (⚠ 'goodly' XATO)
  fast → fast   (o'zgarmaydi)
  hard → hard   (o'zgarmaydi)
  late → late   (o'zgarmaydi)
  early → early (o'zgarmaydi)

  ⚠ 'hardly' MAVJUD, lekin ma'nosi
  BOShQA: 'deyarli emas'.
     'He works HARD.' = qattiq ishlaydi
     'He HARDLY works.' = deyarli
        ishlamaydi

  ⚠ 'lately' ham boshqa ma'noda:
  'so'nggi paytlarda'.


⚠ -LY BILAN TUGAGAN SIFATLAR:

  friendly, lovely, lonely, silly,
  ugly, likely

  ⚠ Bular SIFAT, ravish EMAS!
  ⚠ Ulardan ravish yasash uchun
  'in a ... way' ishlatiladi:
  'in a friendly way'.


⚠ HIS FE'LLARIDAN KEYIN SIFAT:

  be, look, seem, sound, feel, taste,
  smell, become, get

  ⚠ Bulardan keyin SIFAT keladi,
  ravish EMAS:
     'She looks BEAUTIFUL.'
        ('beautifully' XATO)
     'It sounds GOOD.' ('well' XATO)
     'The food tastes DELICIOUS.'

  ⚠ Hikoyada: 'You LOOK as if ...',
  'It SOUNDS like ...'


⚠ HIKOYaDAGI RAVIShLAR:

  heavily  - qattiq (yomg'ir)
  sweetly  - shirin ohangda
  jokingly - hazillashib
  loudly   - baland ovozda
  softly   - ohista
  still    - hamon
  no longer - endi ... emas

exercises.instructionEn: Form: We form the past continuous with was/were and the present participle of the main verb (verb + ing).
exercises.instructionUz: Yasalishi: Past continuous 'was/were' va asosiy fe'lning -ing shakli bilan yasaladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'FORM' QUTISI.

  'We form the past continuous with
   WAS/WERE (past tense of the verb
   TO BE) and the PRESENT PARTICIPLE
   of the main verb (verb + ing).'


AFFIRMATIVE (tasdiq):
  I / he / she / it WAS eating
  we / you / they   WERE eating

NEGATIVE (inkor):
  I / he / she / it WASN'T eating
  we / you / they   WEREN'T eating

INTERROGATIVE (so'roq):
  WAS I / he / she / it eating?
  WERE we / you / they eating?

SHORT ANSWERS (qisqa javob):
  Yes, I / he / she / it WAS.
  No, he / she / it WASN'T.
  Yes, we / you / they WERE.
  No, we / you / they WEREN'T.


⚠ 'WAS' va 'WERE' - KIM BILAN:

  WAS  - I, he, she, it
  WERE - we, you, they

  ⚠ DIQQAT: 'I WAS' (hozirgi zamonda
  'I am' bo'lgani kabi), lekin
  'YOU WERE' (hatto bitta odam
  bo'lsa ham).


⚠ -ING QO'ShISh QOIDALARI:

  eat   → eating   (oddiy)
  make  → making   (oxirgi 'e' TUShADI)
  sit   → sitting  (qisqa unli + bitta
                    undosh → IKKILANADI)
  lie   → lying    (-ie → -ying)
  travel → travelling (Britaniyada 'l'
                    ikkilanadi)


⚠ 'A PRESENT PARTICIPLE':

  = -ing shakli.
  ⚠ 'present' bu yerda 'hozirgi zamon'
  emas - shunchaki shaklning nomi.
  ⚠ U past continuous da ham,
  present continuous da ham bir xil.


⚠ TO'RT QO'LLANISh (17-mashq):

  a) IKKI YoKI UNDAN KO'P ish BIR
     VAQTDA:
     'She WAS WEARING a dress and she
      WAS HOLDING flowers.'

  b) HIKOYaNING FONI:
     'It WAS RAINING heavily outside.'

  c) UZUN ishni QISQA ish BO'LDI:
     'She WAS WATCHING TV when the
      doorbell RANG.'

  d) O'TMIShNING ANIQ PAYTIDA davom
     etayotgan ish:
     'It was half past ten and Janice
      WAS WAITING for her husband.'

exercises.instructionEn: Adjectives describe nouns: We live in a small village. Adjectives ending in -ing (interesting, amazing) describe what somebody or something is like: The film was boring. She is a very interesting person. Adjectives ending in -ed (amazed, surprised, puzzled) describe how somebody feels: The children were terrified when they heard the thunder. Adverbs describe verbs, other adverbs or adjectives: He works hard. He runs very fast. She is extremely polite. Adverbs usually go after verbs. They can also go before verbs (adverbs of frequency): She spoke softly. He always drives carefully.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlar otlarni tasvirlaydi: Biz kichik qishloqda yashaymiz. -ing bilan tugaydigan sifatlar (interesting, amazing) kim/nima QANDAY ekanini bildiradi: Film zerikarli edi. U juda qiziqarli inson. -ed bilan tugaydigan sifatlar (amazed, surprised, puzzled) kim o'zini QANDAY HIS QILIShINI bildiradi: Bolalar momaqaldiroqni eshitib qo'rqib ketishdi. Ravishlar fe'l, boshqa ravish yoki sifatni tasvirlaydi: U qattiq ishlaydi. U juda tez yuguradi. U nihoyatda muloyim. Ravishlar odatda fe'ldan KEYIN keladi; chastota ravishlari fe'ldan OLDIN ham kelishi mumkin: U sekin gapirdi. U har doim ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:

    a SMALL village
  RAVISh → FE'Lni (yoki sifat/

  ⚠ 'I'm boring' = men zerikarli
  odamman! 'I'm bored' = zerikdim.


RAVISh O'RNI:

  Fe'ldan KEYIN: She spoke SOFTLY.
  Chastota ravishi fe'ldan OLDIN:
    He ALWAYS drives carefully.

exercises.instructionEn: Form: We usually form an adverb by adding -ly to the adjective: dangerous - dangerously. When the adjective ends in -le we drop the -e and add -y: gentle - gently. When the adjective ends in a consonant + y we drop the -y and add -ily: easy - easily. When the adjective ends in -l we add -ly: wonderful - wonderfully. Some adverbs have either a totally different form or the same form as the adjective: good - well; fast - fast; hard - hard; early - early; late - late. Note: The following words end in -ly but they are adjectives: friendly, lively, lonely, lovely, silly, ugly. He's a friendly person.

Undosh + y bilan tugasa, -y tushib -ily qo'shiladi: easy - easily. -l bilan tugasa, -ly qo'shiladi: wonderful - wonderfully. Ba'zi ravishlar butunlay boshqa yoki sifat bilan bir xil shaklda: good - well; fast - fast; hard - hard; early - early; late - late. Eslatma: quyidagi so'zlar -ly bilan tugaydi, lekin SIFAT: friendly, lively, lonely, lovely, silly, ugly. U do'stona odam.

     slow → slowly

  2) -LE: -e → -y

     terrible → terribly

  3) UNDOSh + Y: -y → -ily
     easy → easILY
     happy → happily

  4) -L: + -ly (ikkita l!)

  yaqinda.


⚠ -LY BILAN TUGAYDIGAN SIFATLAR:

  friendly, lively, lonely, lovely,
  silly, ugly - bular RAVISh EMAS:
  He's a FRIENDLY person.

exercises.instructionEn: Form: We form the past continuous with was/were and the main verb with -ing: I was working. They were working. Questions: was/were before the subject; negations: not after was/were: Was he working? They weren't working. Use: for an action in progress at a stated time in the past (we do not know when it started or finished): At five o'clock yesterday I was cooking dinner. For a past action in progress when another action interrupted it - past continuous for the longer action, past simple for the shorter action: She was having breakfast when the phone rang. For two or more simultaneous actions in the past: Tina was doing the washing-up while the children were playing in the garden. To give background information in a story: The sun was shining brightly as Tom was driving his brand new car through the city centre. Time expressions: while, when, as. Note: when/while/as + past continuous (longer action); when + past simple (shorter action).
exercises.instructionUz: Shakl: was/were + asosiy fe'l-ing: I was working. They were working. Savol: was/were egadan oldin; inkor: was/were dan keyin not: Was he working? They weren't working. Ishlatilishi: o'tmishda MA'LUM PAYTDA davom etayotgan harakat (qachon boshlangani/tugagani noma'lum): Kecha soat beshda men ovqat pishirayotgan edim. O'tmishda BIR VAQTDA bo'lgan ikki+ harakat: Tina idish yuvayotganda bolalar bog'da o'ynayotgan edi. tasks.en: Form: We form the past continuous with was/were and the main verb with -ing: I was working. They were working. Questions: was/were before the subject; negations: not after was/were: Was he working? They weren't working. Use: for an action in progress at a stated time in the past (we do not know when it started or finished): At five o'clock yesterday I was cooking dinner. For a past action in progress when another action interrupted it - past continuous for the longer action, past simple for the shorter action: She was having breakfast when the phone rang. For two or more simultaneous actions in the past: Tina was doing the washing-up while the children were playing in the garden. To give background information in a story: The sun was shining brightly as Tom was driving his brand new car through the city centre. Time expressions: while, when, as. Note: when/while/as + past continuous (longer action); when + past simple (shorter action).

VAQT IBORALARI - PAST SIMPLE va

    'two weeks ago'

    bilan (bu yerda EMAS)

GAP URG'USI MA'NONI O'ZGARTIRADI.

  ⚠ Bu unitning talaffuz mavzusi -

  sentence stress' deb yozilgan edi.


⚠ ASOSIY G'OYA:

  Bir xil gap, lekin BOShQA so'zga
  urg'u tushsa - MA'NO O'ZGARADI.

  ⚠ Bu - o'zbek tilida ham bor, lekin
  ingliz tilida ancha kuchliroq.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  'I was here at SIX o'clock.'
     (urg'u 'six' da)
  → 'not at seven o'clock'
     (BELGILANGAN)

  ⚠ Agar urg'u 'here' da bo'lsa:
  'I was HERE at six o'clock.'
  → 'not somewhere else'


QOLGAN GAPLAR (urg'u AUDIODAN):

  * ⚠ 2  'A young woman was standing at
    the door.'

          woman
       urg'u 'woman' da → not a young man

  * ⚠ 3  'They were both very sad.'
       urg'u 'both' da → not just one
          of them
       urg'u 'sad' da → they weren't
          happy

  * ⚠ 4  'He was cooking in the kitchen.'
       urg'u 'cooking' da → he wasn't
          eating
       urg'u 'kitchen' da → not in the
          bedroom

  * ⚠ 5  'This is my grandmother.'

  URG'U TUShGAN SO'Z - AYNAN ShU

  ⚠ 'I was here at SIX' → vaqt muhim

  word stress - SO'Z ichidagi urg'u
     ('PHOtograph' - 'phoTOgrapher')
  sentence stress - GAP ichidagi urg'u
     (bu mashqning mavzusi)

  ⚠ 9-unitning talaffuz mavzusi -
  'word stress'.

HIKOYaNI QAYTA SO'ZLASh.

  ⚠ Ro'yxatdagi so'zlar hikoyaning
  KETMA-KETLIGI bo'yicha berilgan -
  ularga qarab hikoyani boshdan-oxir
  aytish mumkin.


RO'YXAT (kitobdagi tartibda):

  watching TV, doorbell rang, young
  woman, long white dress, bouquet of
  flowers, called for a taxi, woman
  wasn't there, doormat, cancelled the
  call, puzzled, sat on the stairs,
  ghost, guest room, clock ticking, old
  photograph, wedding day, gasped in
  amazement, same white dress, 15th
  April, wedding anniversary


⚠ QAYSI ZAMONDA SO'ZLASh:

  Hikoya O'TGAN ZAMONDA:
     PAST CONTINUOUS - fon
     PAST SIMPLE - voqealar

  ⚠ 'Janice WAS WATCHING TV when the
  doorbell RANG.'


⚠ KETMA-KETLIK SO'ZLARI:

  First, ... - avval
  Then, ... - keyin
  After that, ... - shundan keyin
  Later, ... - keyinroq
  Finally, ... - nihoyat
  In the end, ... - oxir-oqibat

  ⚠ Bu so'zlar hikoyani BOG'LAYDI va
  tinglovchiga yo'l ko'rsatadi.

tasks.en: First, Janice was watching TV when the doorbell rang.

⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS (fon) + PAST SIMPLE (voqea).
⚠ Bu - butun hikoyaning grammatik qolipi.

tasks.en: She opened the door and saw a young woman in a long white dress with a bouquet of flowers.
tasks.uz: U eshikni ochdi va uzun oq ko'ylakdagi, qo'lida guldastali yosh ayolni ko'rdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ Ikki fe'l bitta ega bilan: 'opened AND saw'.
⚠ 'in a dress' = ko'ylakda (kiyim uchun 'in').

tasks.en: Then Janice called for a taxi, but when she went back, the woman wasn't there and the flowers were lying on the doormat.
tasks.uz: Keyin Janice taksi chaqirdi, lekin qaytib kelganda ayol u yerda yo'q edi va gullar poyandozda yotardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to call FOR a taxi' - predlog 'for'.
⚠ 'were lying' - PAST CONTINUOUS.

tasks.en: She cancelled the call and sat on the stairs, puzzled.
tasks.uz: U chaqiruvni bekor qildi va hayron bo'lib zinapoyaga o'tirdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'cancelled' - Britaniyada ikki 'l'.
⚠ 'puzzled' - SIFAT ('hayron bo'lgan').

tasks.en: When James got home, she told him about the woman. He joked that she looked as if she had seen a ghost.
tasks.uz: Jeyms uyga kelganda, u ayol haqida aytib berdi. Jeyms hazillashib, u arvoh ko'rganga o'xshaydi, dedi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to tell sb ABOUT sth' - predlog 'about'.
⚠ 'as if' = ... ga o'xshab.

tasks.en: Later, James heard a clock ticking in the guest room and found an old photograph next to it.
tasks.uz: Keyinroq Jeyms mehmonxonada soat chiqillashini eshitdi va uning yonidan eski suratni topdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a clock ticking' - -ING shakli jarayonni
bildiradi.
⚠ 'next to' = yonida.

tasks.en: It was a wedding day photograph dated 15th April, 1910.
tasks.uz: Bu 1910-yil 15-aprel sanasi qo'yilgan to'y kuni surati edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'dated' = sana qo'yilgan.
⚠ Britaniya sanasi: kun → oy → yil.

tasks.en: Finally, he showed it to Janice, who gasped in amazement: the bride was the young woman, and today was her wedding anniversary.
tasks.uz: Nihoyat, u buni Janice'ga ko'rsatdi va u hayratdan nafasi bo'g'ildi: kelin o'sha yosh ayol edi va bugun uning to'y yilligi edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'Finally' - xulosani boshlaydi.
⚠ 'to gasp in amazement' - turg'un ibora.
⚠ 'who' - nisbiy olmosh (12-unit mavzusi).

TA'SSUROT SO'RASh VA AYTISh.

KITOBDAGI DIALOG:
  A: How was your holiday?
  B: It was fantastic/boring.
  A: Was the weather good?
  B: Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.
     It was awful.


⚠ 'HOW WAS ...?':

  ⚠ Bu - tajriba haqida so'rashning
  eng oddiy qolipi.
  ⚠ 'What was it like?' ham to'g'ri.


⚠ QISQA JAVOB:

  'Was the weather good?'
     - 'Yes, it WAS.' / "No, it WASN'T."

  ⚠ Qisqa javobda savoldagi FE'L
  takrorlanadi.
  ⚠ Tasdiqda QISQARTMA IShLATILMAYDI:
  "Yes, it's" - XATO.


KO'RSATMALAR (yangi dialoglar uchun):

  • your Maths exam/awful -
    the questions/difficult?
  • the play/boring -

  • the lecture/long -
    the lecturer/interesting?

  ⚠ Har ko'rsatmada IKKI qism:
     1) umumiy taassurot
     2) tafsilot haqida savol


⚠ SIFATLAR 12-MAShQDAN:

  fantastic, boring, awful, difficult,
  good, long, interesting, cheap -
  hammasi 12-mashqda o'rganilgan.


⚠ 'A LECTURE' va 'A LECTURER':

  a lecture = ma'ruza (16-betdagi
     dialogda ham bor edi)
  a lecturer = ma'ruzachi, o'qituvchi
     (universitetda)

exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
'WHEN', 'WHILE', 'AS' BILAN GAP.


⚠ QOIDA:

  WHILE / AS + PAST CONTINUOUS
     (uzun ish)
  WHEN + PAST SIMPLE
     (qisqa ish)

  ⚠ Lekin BOSh GAP teskari bo'ladi:

  'I WAS WALKING down the street WHEN
   I SAW an accident.'
     uzun ish → past continuous
     'when' dan keyin → past simple

  'WHILE I WAS LEAVING the shop, it
   STARTED to rain.'
     'while' dan keyin → past continuous
     bosh gap → past simple


⚠ BETDAGI BESh GAP:

  1  'I was walking down the street
     yesterday WHEN ...'
     → 'when' dan keyin PAST SIMPLE

  2  'AS I was leaving the shop, ...'
     → bosh gapda PAST SIMPLE

  3  'I was lying on the beach WHEN ...'
     → 'when' dan keyin PAST SIMPLE

  4  'WHILE I was eating my dinner last
     night, ...'
     → bosh gapda PAST SIMPLE

  5  'Jenny was typing a letter WHILE
     ...'
     → 'while' dan keyin PAST CONTINUOUS
        (ikki uzun ish BIR VAQTDA)


⚠ 5-BAND - BOShQAChA:

  'Jenny was typing a letter WHILE
   her boss WAS TALKING on the phone.'

  ⚠ Bu yerda IKKI UZUN ish bir vaqtda -
  17-mashqning 'a' qo'llanishi.
  ⚠ Shuning uchun 'while' dan keyin
  ham PAST CONTINUOUS.


⚠ 'AS' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) ... paytda (= while)
     'AS I was leaving ...'
  2) chunki (= because)
     'AS it was raining, we stayed in.'

  ⚠ 28-betdagi 11-mashq namunasida ham
  birinchi ma'noda edi.


⚠ VERGUL QOIDASI:

  Ergash gap BOShDA bo'lsa - VERGUL:
     'While I was eating, the phone
      rang.'
  Ergash gap OXIRDA bo'lsa - vergul YO'Q:
     'The phone rang while I was eating.'

  ⚠ Betdagi 2 va 4-gaplarda vergul BOR -
  chunki ergash gap boshda.

exercises.explanationUz:
GUVOHNING KO'RSATUVI.

  ⚠ Politsiya guvohdan so'raydi:
  nima bo'ldi, qayerda eding, nima
  qilayotgan eding.

  ⚠ Bu - 8-betdagi modul rejasida
  aytilgan mavzu: 'report events
  (as a witness)'.


⚠ QAYSI ZAMON QAYERDA:

  PAST SIMPLE - bo'lib o'tgan VOQEA:
     1 happened - nima sodir bo'ldi
     2 was - qanday voqea edi
     3 were you - qayerda eding
     4 was - qayerda edim

  PAST CONTINUOUS - o'sha paytda DAVOM
  ETAYoTGAN ish:
     5 were you doing - nima
        qilayotgan eding
     6 was cutting - o'rayotgan edim


⚠ 3 va 5-SAVOLLARNING FARQI:

  'Where WERE you at the time?'
     = qayerda eding? (HOLAT → simple)
  'What WERE you DOING?'
     = nima qilayotgan eding?
       (ISh → continuous)

  ⚠ 'be' fe'li CONTINUOUS shaklda
  ishlatilmaydi, shuning uchun
  3-bandda faqat 'were'.


⚠ 'AT THE TIME':

  = o'sha paytda.
  ⚠ 'at that time' bilan bir xil.


⚠ 'EXACTLY':

  'What EXACTLY happened?'
  = aynan nima bo'ldi?
  ⚠ Savolni ANIQROQ qiladi -
  25-betdagi 4-mashqda ham bor edi.


⚠ 'A ROBBERY' va 'A BURGLARY':

  a robbery = qaroqchilik (odamdan
     yoki bankdan, KUCh bilan)
  a burglary = o'g'irlik (uyga
     tunab kirish)

  ⚠ Ko'rsatmalarda ikkalasi ham bor.
  ⚠ 'a robber' - 27-betdagi 7-mashqda
  bor edi.


⚠ 'A NEIGHBOURHOOD':

  = mahalla, atrof.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'neighbourhood',
  AQShda 'neighborhood'.


KO'RSATMALAR (yangi dialoglar uchun):

  • a burglary next door - in my bedroom
    - sleep
  • a robbery at the bank - outside the
    bank - talk to the security guard

  ⚠ Har ko'rsatmada UCh qism:
     nima bo'ldi - qayerda eding -
     nima qilayotgan eding

exercises.explanationUz:
GUVOH HISOBOTI - BANK O'G'IRLIGI.

  ⚠ Asosan PAST SIMPLE (voqealar):
  saw, was, happened, heard, went,
  Did ... arrive, caught, escaped,
  dropped.
  ⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - fon:
  'as he WAS RUNNING AWAY he
  dropped' (qochayotganda tushirdi).
  ⚠ SO'ROQ: 'Were you at home?',
  'Did the police arrive?'


⚠ 'A WITNESS':

  = guvoh. 'a witness' report' =
  guvoh hisoboti.


⚠ 'WHAT'S GOING ON?':

  = Nima bo'lyapti?


⚠ 'A BANK ROBBERY':

  = bank o'g'irligi. 'a robber' =
  o'g'ri, qaroqchi. 'to rob' =
  o'g'irlamoq (joyni).


⚠ 'ON MY WAY HERE':

  = bu yerga kelayotganimda.


⚠ 'TO HAVE A LOOK':

  = qarab ko'rmoq.


⚠ 'IN TIME':

  = o'z vaqtida (kech emas).


⚠ 'TO ESCAPE':

exercises.instructionEn: Beginnings - Endings
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyaning boshlanishi va tugashi
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI.

  'At the BEGINNING of a story, we say
   WHERE and WHEN the story takes
   place, WHO the people are, and WHAT
   happened first.'

  'At the END of a story, we write WHAT
   HAPPENED IN THE END and HOW THE
   PEOPLE FELT.'


BOShLANIShDA TO'RT SAVOL:

  WHERE? - qayerda
  WHEN?  - qachon
  WHO?   - kim
  WHAT happened first? - avval nima
           bo'ldi

  ⚠ 20-mashqning 1-5 savollari aynan
  shu to'rt savolga tegishli.


TUGAShDA IKKI SAVOL:

  What happened in the end? - oxirida
     nima bo'ldi
  How did the people feel? - odamlar
     o'zini qanday his qildi

  ⚠ 20-mashqning 6-savoli aynan shu.


⚠ 27-BETDAGI HIKOYa ShU QOIDAGA
MOS KELADI:

  BOShLANIShI:
     WHEN: 'It was half past ten at
        night'
     WHERE: 'in the house'
     WHO: 'Janice ... her husband'
     WHAT FIRST: 'the doorbell rang'

  TUGAShI:
     WHAT IN THE END: 'that's her in the
        photograph'
     HOW FELT: 'gasped in amazement'


⚠ 'TO TAKE PLACE':

  = bo'lib o'tmoq, sodir bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 23-betdagi 29-mashqda ham bor edi.


⚠ 'IN THE END' va 'AT THE END':

  in the end = oxir-oqibat, natijada
  at the end (of sth) = ... ning
     oxirida

  ⚠ 'IN THE END he came.' = oxir-oqibat
  keldi.
  ⚠ 'AT THE END of the film ...' =
  filmning oxirida.

  ⚠ Qutida IKKALASI ham bor - farqni
  seziing.

LAURA HAQIDAGI HIKOYaNING BOShI VA
OXIRI.


⚠ QAYSI ZAMON QAYERDA:

  PAST CONTINUOUS - fon va uzun ish:
     1 was staring (fon)
     3 was travelling (fon)
     5 was wearing (tasvir)
     6 was carrying (tasvir)
     14 was waiting (fon)

  PAST SIMPLE - qisqa, ketma-ket ish:
     2 was ('be' - HOLAT fe'li!)
     4 entered
     7 sat
     8 opened
     9 took
     10 gave
     11 got
     12 put
     13 walked
     15 thought


⚠ 2-BANDGA DIQQAT:

  'It 2) ... (be) Christmas Eve.'
  → 'It WAS Christmas Eve.'

  ⚠ 'be' - HOLAT fe'li, CONTINUOUS
  shaklda ISHLATILMAYDI.
  ⚠ 'It was being Christmas Eve' - XATO.


⚠ 4-BAND - 'SUDDENLY':

  'SUDDENLY an elderly gentleman
   4) ... (enter) her compartment.'
  → ENTERED

  ⚠ 'suddenly' = to'satdan - QISQA,
  kutilmagan ish belgisi → PAST SIMPLE.
  ⚠ Bu ish uzun 'was staring' ishini
  BO'LADI (17-mashqning 'c'
  qo'llanishi).


⚠ 7-10 BANDLAR - KETMA-KET IShLAR:

  sat → opened → took → gave

  ⚠ Hammasi PAST SIMPLE, chunki ular
  BIRIN-KETIN sodir bo'ladi.
  ⚠ Continuous bo'lsa, ular BIR VAQTDA
  bo'lgan bo'lardi - bu mantiqsiz.


⚠ NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:

  take → took
  give → gave
  get  → got
  put  → put (O'ZGARMAYDI)
  sit  → sat
  think → thought


⚠ 12-BAND - 'PUT':

  'carefully 12) ... (put) the envelope'
  → PUT

  ⚠ 'put' - o'tgan zamonda ham 'put'!
  ⚠ 'putted' - XATO.


⚠ 'CHRISTMAS EVE':

  = Rojdestvo arafasi (24-dekabr).
  ⚠ 'an eve' = arafa.
  ⚠ 'New Year's Eve' = Yangi yil arafasi.


⚠ 'A COMPARTMENT':

  = poyezd kupesi.


⚠ 'AN ENVELOPE':

  = konvert.
  ⚠ /ˈenvələʊp/ deb o'qiladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaGA BOSh VA OXIR YoZISh.


BOShLANISh - TO'RT SAVOLGA JAVOB:

  1) WHEN - qachon
     'It was a cold winter evening ...'
     'It was Christmas Eve ...'

  2) WHERE - qayerda
     '... on a train.'
     '... in a small village.'

  3) WHO - kim
     'Laura was travelling home ...'

  4) WHAT HAPPENED FIRST - avval nima
     'Suddenly, an elderly gentleman
      entered her compartment.'

  ⚠ 'SUDDENLY' - hikoyada voqeani
  boshlashning eng qulay so'zi.


TUGASh - IKKI SAVOLGA JAVOB:

  1) WHAT HAPPENED IN THE END
     'In the end, she found out that
      ...'

  2) HOW THE PEOPLE FELT
     'She felt very happy / sad /
      relieved.'

  ⚠ His-tuyg'u sifatlari 28-betdagi
  15-mashqda: thrilled, anxious,
  nervous, sad, puzzled, amazed.


⚠ QAYSI ZAMONLAR:

  FON va TASVIR → PAST CONTINUOUS
     'It was raining ...'
     'She was wearing ...'

  VOQEALAR → PAST SIMPLE
     'He entered ...'
     'She opened ...'

  ⚠ Bu - 20-mashqdagi matnning
  AYNAN qolipi.


⚠ KETMA-KETLIK SO'ZLARI:

  Suddenly, ... - to'satdan
  Then, ... - keyin
  After that, ... - shundan keyin
  Finally, ... - nihoyat
  In the end, ... - oxir-oqibat


⚠ 'AN EXTRACT':

  = parcha (matndan).
  ⚠ 'to extract' = ajratib olmoq.

tasks.en: It was a cold, wet evening in November and Tom was walking home through the empty park.
tasks.uz: Noyabrning sovuq, nam kechasi edi va Tom bo'sh bog' orqali uyiga piyoda ketayotgan edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ FON → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ Ob-havo va joy - hikoyaning FONI
(17-mashqning 'b' qo'llanishi).

tasks.en: He was carrying a heavy bag and he was thinking about his exam the next day.
tasks.uz: U og'ir sumka ko'targan va ertangi imtihoni haqida o'ylayotgan edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ Ikki ish BIR VAQTDA → PAST CONTINUOUS
(17-mashqning 'a' qo'llanishi).

tasks.en: Suddenly, he heard a strange noise behind him. He turned round and saw a small dog running towards him.
tasks.uz: To'satdan u orqasida g'alati shovqin eshitdi. U o'girildi va o'zi tomon yugurib kelayotgan kichkina itni ko'rdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'SUDDENLY' + PAST SIMPLE - uzun ishni BO'LADI
(17-mashqning 'c' qo'llanishi).
⚠ 'saw a dog RUNNING' - -ING shakli jarayonni
bildiradi.

tasks.en: In the end, Tom took the dog home and found its owner the next morning.
tasks.uz: Oxir-oqibat Tom itni uyiga olib ketdi va ertasi ertalab egasini topdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'in the end' = oxir-oqibat.
⚠ Ketma-ket voqealar → PAST SIMPLE.

tasks.en: The owner was thrilled to see his dog again, and Tom felt very happy. It was a day he would never forget.
tasks.uz: Egasi itini yana ko'rganidan juda xursand bo'ldi, Tom esa o'zini juda baxtli his qildi. Bu u hech qachon unutmaydigan kun edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ His-tuyg'u sifatlari 28-betdagi 15-mashqdan.
⚠ 'a day he would never forget' - unit nomiga
ishora: 'Days to Remember'.

exercises.instructionEn: When we write a story, we first decide on a plot line (a series of events that lead up to the main event). We can divide our story into four paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoya yozganda avval syujet chizig'ini (asosiy voqeaga olib boradigan voqealar zanjirini) belgilaymiz. Hikoyani to'rt xatboshiga bo'lish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI - HIKOYa YoZISh QOIDASI.


⚠ 'A PLOT LINE':

  = syujet chizig'i.
  ⚠ 'a plot' = syujet, voqealar zanjiri.
  ⚠ 'a series of events that LEAD UP TO
  the main event' = asosiy voqeaga
  OLIB BORADIGAN voqealar zanjiri.

  ⚠ Ya'ni avval REJA tuziladi, keyin
  yoziladi.


TO'RT XATBOShI:

  1-xatboshi:
     QAChON va QAYERDA bo'ldi
     KIM ishtirok etadi
     AVVAL nima bo'ldi

  2 va 3-xatboshilar:
     ASOSIY voqeadan OLDIN nima bo'ldi
     ASOSIY voqeaning O'ZI

  4-xatboshi (oxirgi):
     OXIR-OQIBAT nima bo'ldi
     odamlar o'zini QANDAY his qildi

  ⚠ Bu - 29-betdagi 'Beginnings -
  Endings' qutisining kengaytmasi.


⚠ VOQEALAR TARTIBI:

  'We usually write the events IN THE
   ORDER THEY HAPPENED.'
  = voqealarni SODIR BO'LGAN TARTIBDA
    yozamiz.

  ⚠ 29 va 23-mashqlar aynan shuni
  mashq qildiradi.


⚠ HIKOYaNI QIZIQARLI QILISh:

  1) ACTUAL WORDS (direct speech)
     = to'g'ri nutq, tirnoq ichida
     "'This is fantastic!' she
      shouted."

  2) A VARIETY OF ADJECTIVES
     = turli sifatlar
     huge, bright, worried, dark

  3) ADVERBS
     = ravishlar
     cheerfully, violently, anxiously,
     calmly

  ⚠ 30-betdagi hikoyada uchalasi ham
  ko'p ishlatilgan.


⚠ ZAMONLAR:

  'We normally use the PAST SIMPLE and
   PAST CONTINUOUS in such pieces of
   writing.'

  ⚠ PAST SIMPLE - voqealar
  ⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - fon va tasvir


⚠ 'A PIECE OF WRITING':

  = yozma ish.
  ⚠ 'writing' SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning
  uchun 'a piece of' kerak
  (13-betda 'a piece of music' bor edi).

tasks.uz: Hikoya yozganda avval syujet chizig'ini (asosiy voqeaga olib boradigan voqealar zanjirini) belgilaymiz.

⚠ 'a plot' = syujet.
⚠ 'to lead up to sth' = ... ga olib bormoq.
⚠ Avval REJA, keyin yozish.

tasks.en: In the first paragraph we say when and where the story happened, who the people in the story are and what happened first.
tasks.uz: Birinchi xatboshida hikoya qachon va qayerda bo'lganini, ishtirokchilar kimligini va avval nima sodir bo'lganini aytamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ TO'RT savol - 29-betdagi quti bilan AYNI.
⚠ WHEN? WHERE? WHO? WHAT FIRST?

tasks.en: In the second and third paragraphs we write what happened before the main event, then describe the main event.
tasks.uz: Ikkinchi va uchinchi xatboshilarda asosiy voqeadan oldin nima bo'lganini yozamiz, so'ng asosiy voqeani tasvirlaymiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ ASOSIY voqea - hikoyaning cho'qqisi.
⚠ 30-betdagi hikoyada asosiy voqea - chaqmoq
va sharning daraxtga qo'nishi.

tasks.en: We usually write the events in the order they happened.
tasks.uz: Voqealarni odatda sodir bo'lgan tartibda yozamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 23 va 29-mashqlar aynan shuni mashq
qildiradi.
⚠ Ketma-ketlik so'zlari yordam beradi:
First, Then, After that, Finally.

tasks.en: In the last paragraph we describe what happened in the end and how the people felt.
tasks.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida oxir-oqibat nima bo'lgani va odamlar o'zini qanday his qilganini tasvirlaymiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 29-betdagi quti bilan AYNI.
⚠ His-tuyg'u sifatlari 28-betdagi 15-mashqda.

tasks.en: We can use someone's actual words (direct speech) as well as a variety of adjectives and adverbs to make our story more interesting.
tasks.uz: Hikoyani qiziqarliroq qilish uchun to'g'ri nutq, turli sifat va ravishlardan foydalanish mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'direct speech' = to'g'ri nutq (tirnoq ichida).
⚠ 30-betdagi hikoyada juda ko'p ravish bor:
cheerfully, violently, anxiously, calmly.

tasks.en: We normally use the past simple and past continuous in such pieces of writing.
tasks.uz: Bunday yozma ishlarda odatda past simple va past continuous ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ PAST SIMPLE - voqealar; PAST CONTINUOUS -
fon va tasvir.
⚠ 'a piece of writing' - 'writing'
SANALMAYDIGAN.

'THE WATERFALL' HIKOYaSINING VOQEALARI.

  ⚠ Kitobda IKKI raqam ALLAQAChON
  qo'yilgan: 1 (Mark & Dan got into
  the canoe) va 5 (They saw a
  waterfall).


TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1  Mark & Dan got into the canoe.
     (BERILGAN)
  2  They saw a kingfisher.
  3  They stopped to have some coffee.
  4  They got back into the canoe.
  5  They saw a waterfall.  (BERILGAN)
  6  Two fishermen pulled the canoe to
     safety.
  7  They thanked the fishermen.


⚠ QANDAY TOPILADI:

  ⚠ 'They GOT BACK into the canoe' -
  'back' so'zi ular AVVAL chiqib
  ketganini bildiradi. Demak undan
  oldin 'They STOPPED to have some
  coffee' bo'lishi kerak.

  ⚠ 'They THANKED the fishermen' -
  baliqchilar YoRDAM BERGANDAN keyin.

  ⚠ 'a kingfisher' - qayiqda ketayotib
  ko'radigan narsa, sharsharadan
  OLDIN.


⚠ 'A KINGFISHER':

  = qirg'ovul, baliqchi qush.
  ⚠ 'king' (shoh) + 'fisher' (baliqchi).
  ⚠ Betdagi dumaloq rasmda aynan shu
  qush - ko'k va to'q sariq patli.


⚠ 'A WATERFALL':

  = sharshara.
  ⚠ 'water' + 'fall' - qo'shma ot.
  ⚠ 9-betdagi Susanning xatida ham
  bor edi.


⚠ 'TO PULL' va 'TO PUSH':

  to pull = tortmoq
  to push = itarmoq

  ⚠ 'pulled the canoe TO SAFETY' =
  qayiqni xavfsiz joyga tortdi.


⚠ 'TO THANK SB':

  ⚠ PREDLOGSIZ: 'thank the fishermen'.
  ⚠ Sabab uchun 'FOR': 'thank sb FOR
  sth'.


⚠ 'A FISHERMAN':

  ⚠ Ko'pligi 'fisherMEN'.
  ⚠ 7-betdagi Tailand matnida ham
  bor edi.

KITOBDAGI REJA:

  INTRODUCTION
     Para 1: start the story
             (who, when, where, what)

  MAIN BODY
     Paras 2-3: develop the story
             (events before the main
              event, the main event
              itself)

  CONCLUSION

              how people felt)


⚠ HAJM: 120-180 SO'Z

  ⚠ Bu - 29-betdagi (100-150) va
  23-betdagi (100-150) topshiriqlardan
  KATTAROQ, chunki hikoya to'liq
  yoziladi.


⚠ 'ENTITLED':

  = ... deb nomlangan.
  ⚠ 'a title' (sarlavha) so'zidan
  (2-betda ham bor edi).


⚠ QANDAY YoZILADI:

  1) 29-mashqdagi yettita voqeani
     tartibga soling
  2) Har voqeani 2-3 gapga kengaytiring
  3) FON qo'shing (ob-havo, joy tasviri)
     - past continuous
  4) TO'G'RI NUTQ qo'shing
     ("..." he said)
  5) SIFAT va RAVISh qo'shing

  ⚠ Bu - 30-betdagi hikoyaning
  AYNAN usuli.


⚠ FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  It was a warm summer morning ...
  Suddenly, ...
  Before they could ...
  At that moment ...
  Fortunately, ...
  In the end, ...
  They felt very relieved.

tasks.en: The Waterfall
tasks.uz: Sharshara
tasks.note:
⚠ Sarlavha kitobda BERILGAN.
⚠ 'entitled' = ... deb nomlangan.

tasks.en: It was a warm summer morning and the sun was shining brightly. Mark and Dan, two old friends, were spending the weekend by the river. After breakfast, they got into their canoe and started rowing down the river.
tasks.uz: Iliq yozgi tong edi va quyosh yorqin porlayotgan edi. Ikki eski do'st Mark va Den dam olish kunlarini daryo bo'yida o'tkazishayotgan edi. Nonushtadan keyin ular qayiqlariga o'tirishdi va daryo bo'ylab eshkak esha boshlashdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ FON → past continuous ('was shining',
'were spending').
⚠ VOQEA → past simple ('got', 'started').
⚠ WHO, WHEN, WHERE, WHAT FIRST - to'rt savol.

tasks.en: As they were rowing, they saw a beautiful kingfisher sitting on a branch. "Look at that!" Mark shouted excitedly. An hour later they were feeling tired, so they stopped to have some coffee on the bank.
tasks.uz: Eshkak eshayotganda ular shoxda o'tirgan chiroyli baliqchi qushni ko'rishdi. "Anavini qara!" - hayajon bilan qichqirdi Mark. Bir soatdan keyin ular charchaganini his qilishdi, shuning uchun qirg'oqda qahva ichish uchun to'xtashdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'As they WERE ROWING' + 'they SAW' -
17-mashqning 'c' qo'llanishi.
⚠ TO'G'RI NUTQ qo'shildi.
⚠ 'to stop TO DO sth' = qilish uchun to'xtamoq.

tasks.en: Soon they got back into the canoe. Suddenly, they heard a loud noise. Before they could do anything, they saw a huge waterfall in front of them. The canoe was moving faster and faster towards it. "We're going to fall!" screamed Dan.
tasks.uz: Ko'p o'tmay ular yana qayiqqa o'tirishdi. To'satdan ular baland shovqin eshitishdi. Biror narsa qilishga ulgurmasidan oldilarida ulkan sharsharani ko'rishdi. Qayiq unga tomon tobora tezroq harakatlanardi. "Yiqilamiz!" - chinqirdi Den.
tasks.note:
⚠ ASOSIY voqea - hikoyaning cho'qqisi.
⚠ 'Suddenly' - burilish nuqtasi.
⚠ 'faster and faster' = tobora tezroq.
⚠ 'to scream' - 30-betdagi hikoyada ham bor edi.

tasks.en: Fortunately, two fishermen were standing on the bank. They threw a rope and pulled the canoe to safety just in time. Mark and Dan thanked them again and again. They felt very relieved and they will never forget that day.
tasks.uz: Yaxshiyamki, qirg'oqda ikki baliqchi turgan edi. Ular arqon tashlashdi va qayiqni o'z vaqtida xavfsiz joyga tortishdi. Mark va Den ularga qayta-qayta rahmat aytishdi. Ular o'zlarini juda yengil his qilishdi va o'sha kunni hech qachon unutmaydilar.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'Fortunately' - 30-betdagi hikoyada ham
bor edi.
⚠ 'relieved' - 28-betdagi 9-mashqda.
⚠ Oxirgi gap UNIT NOMIGA ishora:
'Days to Remember'.

tasks.en:
The Accident

It was raining heavily and I was glad I was sitting in my warm flat. Suddenly, I heard car brakes screeching. I looked out of the window and saw a car in the street. A man and a woman got out of the car and the woman was shouting.

Then I heard the doorbell, but I was afraid to answer it. I heard a bang on the door and then the car engine started. I slowly opened the door and saw a dog. The poor dog was injured, so I took it indoors and called the vet.

After a few days, the dog got better. I decided to keep it, and now it is my best friend.
tasks.uz:
Baxtsiz hodisa

Qattiq yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi va men iliq kvartiramda o'tirganimdan xursand edim. To'satdan mashina tormozining chiyillashini eshitdim. Derazadan qaradim va ko'chada mashinani ko'rdim. Erkak va ayol mashinadan chiqishdi va ayol qichqirayotgan edi.

Keyin eshik qo'ng'irog'ini eshitdim, lekin ochishga qo'rqdim. Eshikda gumburlagan tovush eshitildi, keyin mashina motori yurib ketdi. Sekin eshikni ochdim va itni ko'rdim. Bechora it jarohatlangan edi, shuning uchun uni ichkariga olib kirdim va veterinarni chaqirdim.

Bir necha kundan keyin it tuzaldi. Uni olib qolishga qaror qildim va endi u mening eng yaqin do'stim.

tasks.en:
Carlos's Lucky Find

One summer morning, as he waved goodbye to his grandparents and set off on his bicycle, Carlos had a feeling that it was going to be a very special day. The sun was shining and the sky was clear as he rode towards the hills.

A few hours later, Carlos was breaking some rocks to look for fossils inside, when he noticed a strange-looking rock. It was round and smooth. "That's not a rock!" he thought excitedly. "It's an egg!" He carefully put it in his bag and cycled home as fast as he could.

Carlos's grandfather couldn't believe his eyes when he saw the egg and immediately called the authorities to tell them the exciting news. Early the next morning, Carlos set off on the long hot bus journey to the Carmen Funes Museum in Plaza Huincul with his precious egg. The scientists there were amazed. It was a dinosaur egg!

Over the next few months, scientists found hundreds more dinosaur eggs in the same place. Carlos felt very proud that his story appeared in every newspaper, and he even gave some interviews on television. It really was a day to remember!

Carlosning omadli topilmasi

Bir kuni yoz ertalabi, buvisi-bobosi bilan xayrlashib velosipedda yo'lga chiqarkan, Carlos bu juda alohida kun bo'lishini his qildi. Tepaliklar tomon ketarkan quyosh porlab, osmon musaffo edi.

Bir necha soatdan keyin Carlos ichidan qazilma qidirish uchun toshlarni sindirayotganda g'alati ko'rinishli toshni payqadi. U yumaloq va silliq edi. "Bu tosh emas!" deb o'yladi u hayajon bilan. "Bu tuxum!" U uni ehtiyotkorlik bilan sumkasiga solib, iloji boricha tez uyga haydadi.

Carlosning bobosi tuxumni ko'rganda ko'zlariga ishonolmadi va darhol rasmiylarga qo'ng'iroq qilib hayajonli yangilikni aytdi. Ertasi kuni erta tongda Carlos qimmatbaho tuxumi bilan Plaza Huinkuldagi Karmen Funes muzeyiga uzoq va issiq avtobus safariga chiqdi. U yerdagi olimlar hayratda qolishdi. Bu dinozavr tuxumi edi!

Keyingi bir necha oy davomida olimlar o'sha joydan yana yuzlab dinozavr tuxumlarini topdilar. Carlos hikoyasi har bir gazetada chiqqanidan juda faxrlandi va hatto televideniyeda bir necha intervyu ham berdi. Bu chindan ham esda qoladigan kun edi!

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean? - One story is good till another is told. A tale never loses in the telling.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi? - Bir hikoya boshqasi aytilguncha yaxshi. Hikoya aytilgan sari kamaymaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MAQOL - IKKALASI HAM HIKOYa
HAQIDA.


1) 'ONE STORY IS GOOD TILL ANOTHER
   IS TOLD.'

  So'zma-so'z: 'Bir hikoya boshqasi
  aytilguncha yaxshi'.

  MA'NOSI: Faqat bir tomonni eshitib
  hukm chiqarmang - ikkinchi tomonni
  ham eshiting.

  ⚠ Sud va nizolarda ko'p ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ 'till' = 'until' ning qisqa shakli
  (19-betdagi Parij matnida ham bor
  edi).
  ⚠ 'is told' - MAJHUL NISBAT
  (9-unit mavzusi).

  ⚠ O'zbekchada: 'Bir tomonning gapiga
  quloq solma.'


2) 'A TALE NEVER LOSES IN THE TELLING.'

  So'zma-so'z: 'Hikoya aytilishida
  hech qachon yo'qotmaydi'.

  MA'NOSI: Hikoya har aytilganda
  KATTALAShIB boradi - odamlar
  tafsilotlarni qo'shib yuboradi.

  ⚠ Ya'ni eshitgan hikoyangizga
  butunlay ishonmang.

  ⚠ 'a tale' = hikoya, qissa
  (26-betda 'a fairy tale' bor edi).
  ⚠ 'in the telling' = aytilish
  jarayonida.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada: 'Og'izdan og'izga
  o'tib kattalashadi.'


⚠ NIMA UChUN BU MAQOLLAR ShU YERDA:

  Unit HIKOYa yozish va so'zlash
  haqida. Ikkala maqol ham hikoyaning
  ishonchliligi haqida - unit
  mavzusiga to'g'ri keladi.


⚠ 'A STORY' va 'A TALE':

  a story - hikoya (umumiy so'z)
  a tale - hikoya, qissa (ko'proq
     og'zaki, xalq ijodi)

  ⚠ 'a fairy tale' = ertak.
  ⚠ 'to tell a tale' - 'tell' bilan
  ('say' EMAS).
