sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim] was [fe'l]-ing when [kim] [past simple].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Janice was watching TV when she heard the doorbell.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Janice televizor ko'rayotganda qo'ng'iroq ovozini eshitdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - fon; PAST SIMPLE - uni
bo'lgan ish.
⚠ Bu 4-unitning grammatika mavzusi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim] saw [kim] [fe'l]-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Janice saw a young woman standing at the door.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Janice eshik oldida turgan yosh ayolni ko'rdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ko'rish/eshitish fe'llaridan keyin -ING shakli
JARAYoNNI bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Instead of [kim/nima], [gap].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Instead of her husband, Janice saw a young woman.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Eri o'rniga Janice yosh ayolni ko'rdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'instead of' + OT yoki -ING.
⚠ 'instead' yolg'iz - gap oxirida.

sentencePatterns.formula: I think it is a [hikoya turi], because [sabab].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think it is a ghost story, because the young woman disappears.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, bu arvoh haqidagi hikoya, chunki yosh ayol g'oyib bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Taxminni SABAB bilan asoslash - fikr
bildirishning to'liq shakli.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim] was [fe'l]-ing when [kim] [past simple].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She was watching TV when the doorbell rang.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U televizor ko'rayotganda eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: He/She wasn't [fe'l]-ing. He/She was [fe'l]-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She wasn't reading a book. She was watching TV.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U kitob o'qimayotgan edi. U televizor ko'rayotgan edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Noto'g'ri gapni to'g'rilash: avval INKOR,
keyin TO'G'RI ma'lumot.

sentencePatterns.formula: It sounds like [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It sounds like the clock my grandparents had.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu buvim-bobomdagi soatga o'xshaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'sound LIKE' + OT; 'sound' + SIFAT.
⚠ Xuddi shunday: look like, feel like,
taste like.

sentencePatterns.formula: You look as if you've [3-shakl].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You look as if you've seen a ghost.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Arvoh ko'rganga o'xshaysan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'as if' = ... ga o'xshab.
⚠ 'look' dan keyin SIFAT yoki 'as if' + GAP.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim] said/spoke [ravish].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: "Excuse me," the young woman said sweetly.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: "Kechirasiz", - dedi yosh ayol shirin ohangda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ RAVISh fe'lni tasvirlaydi: QANDAY QILIB aytdi?
⚠ Sifat + -LY.

sentencePatterns.formula: It was [fe'l]-ing [ravish] as [gap].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was raining heavily as John was going back home.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jon uyga qaytayotganda qattiq yomg'ir yog'ardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ RAVISh fe'ldan KEYIN turadi.
⚠ 'as' = ... paytda (ikki uzun ish bir vaqtda).

sentencePatterns.formula: How was [nima]? - It was [sifat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How was your holiday? - It was fantastic.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ta'tiling qanday o'tdi? - Ajoyib.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Tajriba haqida so'rashning asosiy qolipi.
⚠ 'What was it like?' ham to'g'ri.

sentencePatterns.formula: Was/Were [nima] [sifat]? - Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Was the weather good? - No, it wasn't. It was awful.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ob-havo yaxshi edimi? - Yo'q. Dahshat edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Qisqa javobda savoldagi FE'L takrorlanadi.
⚠ Tasdiqda qisqartma IShLATILMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: I could hear [nima] [fe'l]-ing. / I couldn't hear [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I could hear the wind howling. I couldn't hear a tap dripping.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shamolning uvillashini eshitdim. Jo'mrakning tomishini eshitmadim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'hear' fe'li bilan odatda 'can/could'
ishlatiladi.
⚠ Keyin -ING shakli davom etayotgan tovushni
bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: He/She feels [his-tuyg'u].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: "The view is fantastic!" - He feels amazed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: "Manzara ajoyib!" - u hayratda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'feel' - HIS fe'li, keyin SIFAT keladi
('feel badly' XATO).
⚠ -ED sifatlari ODAM haqida.

sentencePatterns.formula: At [vaqt] I was [fe'l]-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: At 6 am last Monday I was getting dressed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'tgan dushanba soat 6 da kiyinayotgan edim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ O'tmishning ANIQ paytida davom etayotgan ish
(17-mashqning 'd' qo'llanishi).

sentencePatterns.formula: He/She wasn't [fe'l]-ing. He/She was [fe'l]-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Paul wasn't hanging out the washing. He was painting the door.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pol kir yoymayotgan edi. U eshikni bo'yayotgan edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ To'g'rilashning IKKI QADAMI: avval INKOR,
keyin TO'G'RI ma'lumot.

sentencePatterns.formula: It was [fon]. Suddenly, [past simple].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was raining heavily. Suddenly, someone knocked on the door.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qattiq yomg'ir yog'ardi. To'satdan kimdir eshikni taqillatdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ FON → past continuous; VOQEA → past simple.
⚠ 'Suddenly' - hikoyada voqeani boshlash so'zi.

sentencePatterns.formula: In the end, [nima bo'ldi]. He/She felt [his-tuyg'u].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In the end, he found the owner. He felt very happy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oxir-oqibat u egasini topdi. U o'zini juda baxtli his qildi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I was [fe'l]-ing when [past simple].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I was walking down the street when I saw an old friend.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'chada ketayotganimda eski do'stimni ko'rib qoldim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ UZUN ish → past continuous;
'when' dan keyin QISQA ish → past simple.

sentencePatterns.formula: While/As I was [fe'l]-ing, [past simple].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: While I was eating my dinner, the telephone rang.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechki ovqat yeyayotganimda telefon jiringladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'while/as' dan keyin UZUN ish.
⚠ Ergash gap BOShDA bo'lsa - VERGUL ShART.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim] was [fe'l]-ing while [kim] was [fe'l]-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jenny was typing a letter while her boss was talking on the phone.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jenni xat yozayotganda boshlig'i telefonda gaplashayotgan edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ IKKI UZUN ish BIR VAQTDA - ikkalasi ham
past continuous (17-mashqning 'a' qo'llanishi).

sentencePatterns.formula: He/She didn't [fe'l]. He/She [past simple].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Fay didn't hit her leg. She hit her head.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Fey oyog'ini urmadi. U boshini urdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "didn't" dan keyin fe'l ODDIY shaklda.
⚠ To'g'rilashning ikki qadami.

sentencePatterns.formula: Its siren was wailing and its lights were flashing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Its siren was wailing and its red lights were flashing brightly.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sirenasi uvillayotgan va qizil chiroqlari yorqin miltillayotgan edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ikki ish bir vaqtda → ikkalasi past continuous.
⚠ 'ITS' - apostrofsiz (egalik).

sentencePatterns.formula: Was he [fe'l]-ing? - Yes, he was. / No, he wasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Was he cooking? - No, he wasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ovqat pishirayotganmidi? - Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ SO'ROQDA 'was' EGADAN OLDIN.
⚠ Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What exactly happened? - There was a [voqea].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What exactly happened yesterday? - There was a robbery in my neighbourhood.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha aynan nima sodir bo'ldi? - Mahallamizda qaroqchilik bo'ldi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Guvoh ko'rsatuvining birinchi savoli.
⚠ 'There WAS' - o'tgan zamonda 'there is'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where were you at the time? - I was in my [joy].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where were you at the time? - I was in my garden.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'sha paytda qayerda edingiz? - Bog'imda edim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ HOLAT → past simple ('was/were').
⚠ 'at the time' = o'sha paytda.

sentencePatterns.formula: What were you doing? - I was [fe'l]-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What were you doing? - I was cutting the grass.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nima qilayotgan edingiz? - Gazon o'rayotgan edim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ ISh → past continuous.
⚠ Oldingi qolip bilan SOLIShTIRING: u yerda
HOLAT, bu yerda ISh.

sentencePatterns.formula: Fortunately, ... In the end, ... They felt [his-tuyg'u].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Fortunately, two fishermen helped them. In the end, they felt very relieved.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yaxshiyamki, ikki baliqchi ularga yordam berdi. Oxir-oqibat ular o'zlarini juda yengil his qilishdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Hikoyani tugatishning qolipi.
⚠ 'Fortunately' + 'In the end' + his-tuyg'u.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + FE'L + RAVISh (-ly)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She spoke softly. He always drives carefully.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U sekin gapirdi. U har doim ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: NIMA + is + SIFAT-ing / KIM + is + SIFAT-ed
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The film was boring. The children were terrified.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Film zerikarli edi. Bolalar qo'rqib ketishdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + was / were + FE'L-ing
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I was eating. They were eating. Was he eating?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men yeyayotgan edim. Ular yeyayotgan edi. U yeyayotganmidi?

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + was/were + V-ing + when + KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She was having breakfast when the phone rang.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U nonushta qilayotganda telefon jiringladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + was/were + V-ing + while + KIM + was/were + V-ing
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tina was doing the washing-up while the children were playing in the garden.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tina idish yuvayotganda bolalar bog'da o'ynayotgan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: At + VAQT + yesterday, KIM + was + V-ing
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: At five o'clock yesterday I was cooking dinner.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha soat beshda men ovqat pishirayotgan edim.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + FE'L + RAVISh / a + SIFAT + OT
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The little boy smiled sweetly. Today is a perfect day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kichkina bola shirin jilmaydi. Bugun ajoyib kun.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Ravish fe'ldan keyin, sifat otdan oldin.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + was + V-ing + when + KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Sue was having a bath when the doorbell rang.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Syu cho'milayotganda eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + was + V-ing + while + KIM + was + V-ing
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Nora was ironing while Jim was cooking dinner.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nora dazmol qilayotganda Jim ovqat pishirayotgan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: As + KIM + was + V-ing, KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: As Laura was running through the park, it started to rain.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Laura park bo'ylab yugurayotganda yomg'ir boshlandi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Was + KIM + V-ing? — No, ... wasn't. ... was + V-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Was Bill picking tomatoes? — No, he wasn't. He was repairing the tractor.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bill pomidor terayotganmidi? — Yo'q. U traktor tuzatayotgan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What were you doing + VAQT? — I was + V-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What were you doing at six o'clock yesterday morning? — I was sleeping.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha ertalab soat oltida nima qilayotgan edingiz? — Uxlayotgan edim.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON + and + O'TGAN ZAMON + as/while + KIM + was + V-ing
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Ruby slipped and fell as she was crossing the street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Rubi ko'chani kesib o'tayotganda sirpanib yiqildi.

sentencePatterns.formula: As + KIM + was + V-ing, KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON + something strange
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: As she was driving down Main Street, she noticed something strange.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Meyn ko'chasi bo'ylab haydab ketayotganda g'alati narsani payqadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X was/were + V-ing when Y + V2.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They were watching a film when the pizza arrived.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pitsa kelganda ular film ko'rayotgan edilar.

sentencePatterns.formula: As X was + V-ing, X + V2.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: As I was getting on the bus, I fell.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Avtobusga chiqayotganimda yiqildim.

sentencePatterns.formula: FE'L + RAVISh (-ly)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The girl smiled sweetly.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qiz shirin jilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It was a + SIFAT + OT that I will never forget.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was a wonderful experience that I will never forget.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu hech qachon unutmaydigan ajoyib tajriba edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X wasn't + V-ing. X was + V-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mr West wasn't walking into the room. He was sitting on a box.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Janob Uest xonaga kirmayotgan edi. U quti ustida o'tirgan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X + V2 while Y was + V-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The loudspeaker broke while the band was playing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Guruh ijro etayotganda karnay buzildi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It was + V-ing as X + V2.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was snowing heavily as the climbers reached the camp.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Alpinistlar lagerga yetganda qattiq qor yog'ayotgan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X + V2, so Y + V2.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It stopped raining, so the children went out to play.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yomg'ir to'xtadi, shuning uchun bolalar tashqariga chiqishdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: We were + V-ing when suddenly + past simple.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We were driving down the motorway when suddenly the car broke down.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz avtomagistral bo'ylab ketayotgan edik, to'satdan mashina buzilib qoldi.

sentencePatterns.formula: during + OT / while + GAP
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: during the concert / while Steve was doing the washing-up
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: konsert davomida / Stiv idish yuvayotganda

sentencePatterns.formula: Guess who + V2 ...!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Guess who saw us and gave us a lift!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kim bizni ko'rib, olib borganini toping!

sentencePatterns.formula: It was raining heavily and I was + V-ing ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was raining heavily and I was sitting in my warm flat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qattiq yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi va men iliq kvartiramda o'tirgan edim.

sentencePatterns.formula: I cycled along/through/towards + JOY.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I cycled along the coast road towards Longreach.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sohil yo'li bo'ylab Longrich tomon velosipedda yurdim.

sentencePatterns.formula: One day, as I was + V-ing, I + V2.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: One day, as I was walking to the station, I noticed a strange-looking man.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bir kuni vokzalga ketayotganimda g'alati ko'rinishli odamni payqadim.

sentencePatterns.formula: Were you at home when it happened?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Were you at home when it happened? - Yes, but I heard people shouting.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu sodir bo'lganda uyda edingmi? - Ha, lekin odamlar qichqirayotganini eshitdim.

sentencePatterns.formula: Luckily, as X was + V-ing, X + V2.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Luckily, as he was running away he dropped the bag.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Baxtga qarshi, qochayotganda u sumkani tushirib yubordi.

sentencePatterns.formula: While X were + V-ing, X + V2 so that Y could + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: While they were travelling along the canal, they stopped so that Elsa could admire the churches.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kanal bo'ylab ketayotganlarida Elza cherkovlarni tomosha qilishi uchun to'xtashdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: No, it wasn't. / No, she didn't. + TO'G'RI FAKT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: No, it wasn't. A gondola was waiting for them.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'q. Ularni gondola kutayotgan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X couldn't believe his eyes when he saw ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Carlos's grandfather couldn't believe his eyes when he saw the egg.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Carlosning bobosi tuxumni ko'rganda ko'zlariga ishonolmadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Over the next few months, X + V2.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Over the next few months, scientists found hundreds more eggs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Keyingi bir necha oy davomida olimlar yana yuzlab tuxum topdilar.
